entities.summary: Li Sizhong was an ichthyologist with the Institute of Zoology (中国科学院动物研究所) at the Chinese Academy of Sciences. Throughout his research career, he made numerous discoveries of new fish species, and published many books and research papers describing the fauna and geographical distribution of fishes in China and beyond. He translated and helped publication of the Chinese editions of Fishes of the World and Fish Migration. Li was the major author of two published volumes in the Fauna Sinica monograph series, systematically reviewing and describing orders of bony fishes that include flat fish, cod, silverside, pearlfish, killifish, flying fish, etc.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Li Sizhong's contributions to ichthyology significantly advanced our understanding of China's fish fauna and their geographical distribution. His work on the Fauna Sinica monograph series helped systematize the orders of bony fishes, with far-reaching implications for fisheries management and conservation.
